description: Source code for the GLShadowVertexGenerator class, which generates shadow geometry vertices and indices for rendering shadows in OpenGL within the Android render engine.

classes.name: GLShadowVertexGenerator
classes.description: Class responsible for generating shadow geometry vertices and indices for ambient and spot shadows in OpenGL.

methods.name: GLShadowVertexGenerator
methods.description: Constructor that initializes shadow geometries based on input parameters.

methods.name: getVertexCount
methods.description: Returns total number of vertices for both ambient and spot shadows.

methods.name: getIndexCount
methods.description: Returns total number of indices for both ambient and spot shadows.

methods.name: fillVertices
methods.description: Fills vertex arrays with geometry data for rendering shadows.

methods.name: fillIndices
methods.description: Fills index array with geometry indices for rendering shadows.
